translations.web: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.
translations.bsb: Whoever turns his ear away from hearing the law, even his prayer is detestable.
translations.kjv: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
translations.asv: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, Even his prayer is an abomination.
